title: WebGen-Bench 000080 advanced to-do list web application

requirements.name: 新建
requirements.description: Create a new task by filling out the 'Add Task' form and submitting it.

requirements.name: 编辑
requirements.description: Edit an existing task by changing its description and saving the changes.

requirements.name: 标记完成
requirements.description: Mark a specific task as completed on the to-do list.

requirements.name: 删除
requirements.description: Delete a task from the list by selecting the 'Delete' option next to it.

requirements.name: 搜索
requirements.description: Use the search functionality to find a specific task by its title or keywords.

requirements.name: 按完成状态筛选
requirements.description: Filter tasks to show only completed or uncompleted tasks.

requirements.name: 页面导航
requirements.description: Verify the site's navigation by clicking the provided menu items or links in the user interface.

requirements.name: 配色
requirements.description: Verify that the website uses 'lavender' as the background color and 'indigo' as the component color, as specified in the design requirements.
